1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# chart-frontier.bats: the frontier of a decision map (.claude/scripts/chart-frontier.sh, SDD
     3	# D-4.4): open, unblocked, unclaimed question children of the map epic, ordered by bv's graph
     4	# ranks when bv is on PATH. beads is the PATH stub tests/fixtures/charting/br-stub.sh; bv is a
     5	# stub printing fixed ranks. No real beads database is touched.
     6	
     7	setup() {
     8	    REAL="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
     9	    F="$REAL/.claude/scripts/chart-frontier.sh"
    10	    ROOT="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/root"
    11	    mkdir -p "$ROOT/grimoires/loa/maps" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin"
    12	    cp "$REAL/tests/fixtures/charting/br-stub.sh" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin/br"; chmod +x "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin/br"
    13	    export BR_STATE="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/state.json" BR_LOG="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/br.log"
    14	    # epic E; q1 open; q2 blocked by q1; q3 claimed; q4 a task (not a question); q5 under another
    15	    # epic; q6 open; q7 closed
    16	    cat > "$BR_STATE" <<'JSON'
    17	[
    18	 {"id":"E","title":"Map: X","issue_type":"epic","status":"open","assignee":null,"labels":["map"],"parent":null,"deps":[],"priority":2},
    19	 {"id":"q1","title":"First question","issue_type":"question","status":"open","assignee":null,"labels":["decision:grilling"],"parent":"E","deps":[],"priority":2},
    20	 {"id":"q2","title":"Blocked question","issue_type":"question","status":"open","assignee":null,"labels":["decision:research"],"parent":"E","deps":["q1"],"priority":2},
    21	 {"id":"q3","title":"Claimed question","issue_type":"question","status":"in_progress","assignee":"someone","labels":["decision:grilling"],"parent":"E","deps":[],"priority":2},
    22	 {"id":"q4","title":"A task","issue_type":"task","status":"open","assignee":null,"labels":[],"parent":"E","deps":[],"priority":2},
    23	 {"id":"q5","title":"Other map","issue_type":"question","status":"open","assignee":null,"labels":["decision:grilling"],"parent":"OTHER","deps":[],"priority":2},
    24	 {"id":"q6","title":"Sixth\u001b[31m question","issue_type":"question","status":"open","assignee":null,"labels":["decision:unblock"],"parent":"E","deps":[],"priority":1},
    25	 {"id":"q7","title":"Closed question","issue_type":"question","status":"closed","assignee":null,"labels":["decision:grilling"],"parent":"E","deps":[],"priority":2}
    26	]
    27	JSON
    28	    printf '# Map: X\n\n**Slug**: x-map\n**Status**: charting\n**Epic**: E\n' > "$ROOT/grimoires/loa/maps/x-map.md"
    29	    NOBV="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin"
    30	    export PATH="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin:$PATH"
    31	}
    32	
    33	ids() { cut -f1 <<< "$1" | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//'; }
    34	
    35	@test "CF-1 the frontier is the open, unblocked, unclaimed question children of the epic" {
    36	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    37	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    38	    [ "$(ids "$output")" = "q1 q6" ]
    39	}
    40	
    41	@test "CF-2 a map slug resolves through the map doc's Epic line" {
    42	    run "$F" x-map --root "$ROOT"
    43	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    44	    [ "$(ids "$output")" = "q1 q6" ]
    45	    grep -q -- 'ready --parent E --type question --unassigned' "$BR_LOG"
    46	}
    47	
    48	@test "CF-3 titles are printed with control bytes stripped" {
    49	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    50	    ! grep -q $'\033' <<< "$output"
    51	    grep -q $'^q6\tSixth \\[31m question$' <<< "$output"
    52	}
    53	
    54	@test "CF-4 --json prints the filtered br objects" {
    55	    run "$F" E --json --root "$ROOT"
    56	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    57	    [ "$(jq -r '[.[].id] | join(",")' <<< "$output")" = "q1,q6" ]
    58	}
    59	
    60	@test "CF-5 closing a prerequisite moves its dependent onto the frontier" {
    61	    jq -c 'map(if .id == "q1" then .status = "closed" else . end)' "$BR_STATE" > "$BR_STATE.t" && mv "$BR_STATE.t" "$BR_STATE"
    62	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    63	    [ "$(ids "$output")" = "q2 q6" ]
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "CF-6 with bv present, the order follows bv's graph ranks" {
    67	    printf '#!/bin/sh\n[ "$1" = "--robot-triage" ] || exit 2\necho %s\n' "'{\"triage\":{\"recommendations\":[{\"id\":\"q6\"},{\"id\":\"q1\"}]}}'" > "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin/bv"
    68	    chmod +x "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin/bv"
    69	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    70	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    71	    [ "$(ids "$output")" = "q6 q1" ]
    72	}
    73	
    74	@test "CF-7 a bv that errors falls back to br ready order" {
    75	    printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n' > "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin/bv"; chmod +x "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/bin/bv"
    76	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    77	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    78	    [ "$(ids "$output")" = "q1 q6" ]
    79	}
    80	
    81	@test "CF-8 a ready item without a decision label is dropped; output without labels is kept" {
    82	    jq -c 'map(if .id == "q6" then .labels = ["decision:grilling","decision:research"] else . end) | map(if .id == "q1" then del(.labels) else . end)' "$BR_STATE" > "$BR_STATE.t" && mv "$BR_STATE.t" "$BR_STATE"
    83	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    84	    [ "$(ids "$output")" = "q1" ]
    85	}
    86	
    87	@test "CF-9 an empty frontier prints nothing and exits 0" {
    88	    jq -c 'map(if .issue_type == "question" then .status = "closed" else . end)' "$BR_STATE" > "$BR_STATE.t" && mv "$BR_STATE.t" "$BR_STATE"
    89	    run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    90	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    91	    [ -z "$output" ]
    92	}
    93	
    94	@test "CF-10 exit 2 when br is missing" {
    95	    d="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/nobr"; mkdir -p "$d"
    96	    for t in jq bash sed grep cut tr cat dirname; do p="$(command -v "$t")" && ln -sf "$p" "$d/$t"; done
    97	    PATH="$d" run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
    98	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
    99	    [[ "$output" == *"br (beads_rust) is not on PATH"* ]]
   100	}
   101	
   102	@test "CF-11 usage errors exit 2; a map doc without an Epic line exits 1" {
   103	    run "$F" --root "$ROOT"
   104	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   105	    run "$F" 'bad;id' --root "$ROOT"
   106	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   107	    printf '# Map\n**Status**: charting\n' > "$ROOT/grimoires/loa/maps/broken.md"
   108	    run "$F" broken --root "$ROOT"
   109	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   110	}
   111	
   112	@test "CF-12 a failing br ready exits 1" {
   113	    BR_FAIL_ON=ready run "$F" E --root "$ROOT"
   114	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   115	}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# charting-decisions.bats: the /chart command, the charting-decisions skill frontmatter, the map
     3	# template and the shell steps the skill calls (chart-guard.sh, chart-ticket.sh,
     4	# chart-unblock-probe.sh). SDD D-4.1 to D-4.5, D-4.10 to D-4.12.
     5	#
     6	# Hermetic: .claude/scripts is copied into a fresh git repo per file, so the decision-ledger
     7	# writer sees no live run state, no autonomous PRD and no main checkout. beads is a PATH stub
     8	# (tests/fixtures/charting/br-stub.sh); the ledger is a --ledger fixture outside the tree.
     9	
    10	setup_file() {
    11	    export REAL_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"

    14	    cp -R "$REAL_ROOT/.claude/scripts" "$H/.claude/scripts"
    15	    git -C "$H" init -q
    16	    git -C "$H" -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
    17	    mkdir -p "$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin"
    18	    cp "$REAL_ROOT/tests/fixtures/charting/br-stub.sh" "$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin/br"
    19	    chmod +x "$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin/br"
    20	}

    23	    unset LOA_UNATTENDED LOA_FLATLINE_MODE CI GITHUB_ACTIONS LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT BR_FAIL_ON

    25	    mkdir -p "$H/grimoires/loa/maps" "$H/grimoires/loa/research" "$H/grimoires/loa/context" "$H/.beads"
    26	    export BR_STATE="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/br-state.json" BR_LOG="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/br.log"
    27	    echo '[]' > "$BR_STATE"; : > "$BR_LOG"
    28	    export LEDGER="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/decisions.yaml"
    29	    printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n' > "$LEDGER"

    31	    CT="$H/.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh"

    42	path_without_br() {

    44	    for d in $PATH; do [[ -x "$d/br" ]] && continue; out="${out:+$out:}$d"; done
    45	    printf '%s' "$out"

    47	mkmap() {

    52	    ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket cost --label research --question "What is the cost ceiling per run?" --body "Decides the budget alarm."
    53	    ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket bash32 --label unblock --unblocks isolation --question "Does the runner build on bash 3.2?" --body "Settles macOS workers."

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tests/unit/unattended-prototype.bats: the prototype route in the planning
     4	# interview (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-5.1, D-5.7, D-5.8).
     5	#
     6	# The behaviour itself is skill prose; these checks pin what is checkable:
     7	# the config example documents interview.unattended_prototype with both values
     8	# and the default, each planning skill carries the interview rule in at most
     9	# two lines, and the sequencing guidance points at prototype tickets.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup() {
    13	    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    14	    CONFIG="$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml.example"
    15	    SKILLS="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills"
    16	}
    17	
    18	# The interview block's unattended_prototype comment and key, as text.
    19	prototype_block() {
    20	    awk '/^interview:/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { on = 0 } on' "$CONFIG" \
    21	        | awk '/Prototype-class questions/ { on = 1 } on { print } on && /^  unattended_prototype:/ { exit }'
    22	}
    23	
    24	@test "config example: interview.unattended_prototype defaults to defer" {
    25	    if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.'; then
    26	        [ "$(yq '.interview.unattended_prototype' "$CONFIG")" = "defer" ]
    27	    fi
    28	    grep -qE '^  unattended_prototype: defer[[:space:]]+# defer \| halt$' "$CONFIG"
    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "config example: both values are documented with their semantics" {
    32	    local block; block="$(prototype_block)"
    33	    [[ -n "$block" ]]
    34	    # defer: the bead, the open row, the PRD Deferred line, and planning continues
    35	    [[ "$block" == *"defer (default)"* ]]
    36	    [[ "$block" == *"decision:prototype bead"* ]]
    37	    [[ "$block" == *"open DEC row"* ]]
    38	    [[ "$block" == *"**Deferred:** pending prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
    39	    [[ "$block" == *"continue planning"* ]]
    40	    # halt: the same bead and row, then planning stops with the documented message
    41	    [[ "$block" == *"halt: create the same bead and row, then stop planning"* ]]
    42	    [[ "$block" == *"planning halted: prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
    43	}
    44	
    45	@test "config example: the Deferred line it documents is the form the PRD validator recognises" {
    46	    grep -q 'the form is \*\*Deferred:\*\* pending prototype <bead> (DEC-NNNN)' \
    47	        "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
    48	}
    49	
    50	@test "planning skills: each carries the prototype interview rule on at most two lines" {
    51	    local s f n
    52	    for s in discovering-requirements designing-architecture planning-sprints; do
    53	        f="$SKILLS/$s/SKILL.md"
    54	        n="$(grep -c 'I need to see it' "$f")"
    55	        [ "$n" -eq 1 ]
    56	        # the whole rule (through the config key) fits in the matching line and the next
    57	        grep -A1 'I need to see it' "$f" | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -q 'decision:prototype.*never an `\[ASSUMPTION\]`.*interview.unattended_prototype'
    58	    done
    59	}
    60	
    61	@test "planning-sprints REFERENCE: High-Risk Early points at prototype tickets, not spike tasks in build sprints" {
    62	    local ref="$SKILLS/planning-sprints/resources/REFERENCE.md" block
    63	    block="$(awk '/\*\*High-Risk Early\*\*/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[0-9]+\. \*\*/ { exit } on' "$ref")"
    64	    [[ "$block" == *"decision:prototype"* ]]
    65	    [[ "$block" == *"not a spike task inside a build sprint"* ]]
    66	    [[ "$block" != *"Technical spikes"* ]]
    67	}
    68	
    69	@test "planning-sprints: the integration-context list moved to REFERENCE.md behind a pointer" {
    70	    grep -q '§Integration Context' "$SKILLS/planning-sprints/SKILL.md"
    71	    grep -q '^## Integration Context$' "$SKILLS/planning-sprints/resources/REFERENCE.md"
    72	}

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tests/unit/unattended-prototype.bats: the prototype route in the planning
     4	# interview (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-5.1, D-5.7, D-5.8).
     5	#
     6	# The behaviour itself is skill prose; these checks pin what is checkable:
     7	# the config example documents interview.unattended_prototype with both values
     8	# and the default, each planning skill carries the interview rule in at most
     9	# two lines, and the sequencing guidance points at prototype tickets.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup() {
    13	    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    14	    CONFIG="$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml.example"
    15	    SKILLS="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills"
    16	}
    17	
    18	# The interview block's unattended_prototype comment and key, as text.
    19	prototype_block() {
    20	    awk '/^interview:/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { on = 0 } on' "$CONFIG" \
    21	        | awk '/Prototype-class questions/ { on = 1 } on { print } on && /^  unattended_prototype:/ { exit }'
    22	}
    23	
    24	@test "config example: interview.unattended_prototype defaults to defer" {
    25	    if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.'; then
    26	        [ "$(yq '.interview.unattended_prototype' "$CONFIG")" = "defer" ]
    27	    fi
    28	    grep -qE '^  unattended_prototype: defer[[:space:]]+# defer \| halt$' "$CONFIG"
    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "config example: both values are documented with their semantics" {
    32	    local block; block="$(prototype_block)"
    33	    [[ -n "$block" ]]
    34	    # defer: the bead, the open row, the PRD Deferred line, and planning continues
    35	    [[ "$block" == *"defer (default)"* ]]
    36	    [[ "$block" == *"decision:prototype bead"* ]]
    37	    [[ "$block" == *"open DEC row"* ]]
    38	    [[ "$block" == *"**Deferred:** pending prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
    39	    [[ "$block" == *"continue planning"* ]]
    40	    # halt: the same bead and row, then planning stops with the documented message
    41	    [[ "$block" == *"halt: create the same bead and row, then stop planning"* ]]
    42	    [[ "$block" == *"planning halted: prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
    43	}
    44	
    45	@test "config example: the Deferred line it documents is the form the PRD validator recognises" {
    46	    grep -q 'the form is \*\*Deferred:\*\* pending prototype <bead> (DEC-NNNN)' \
    47	        "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
    48	}

    50	@test "planning skills: each carries the prototype interview rule on at most two lines" {

    52	    for s in discovering-requirements designing-architecture planning-sprints; do

    54	        n="$(grep -c 'I need to see it' "$f")"
    55	        [ "$n" -eq 1 ]
    56	        # the whole rule (through the config key) fits in the matching line and the next
    57	        grep -A1 'I need to see it' "$f" | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -q 'decision:prototype.*never an `\[ASSUMPTION\]`.*interview.unattended_prototype'
    58	    done
    59	}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tests/unit/charting-lint.bats: decision tickets stay off the build path
     4	# (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-4.7, D-4.8).
     5	#
     6	#   create-sprint-task.sh refuses type question and a map epic before any bead
     7	#   exists; get-ready-work.sh drops question beads whatever their labels and
     8	#   keeps every other type; the implement path selects work through it;
     9	#   validate-artifact.sh --type sprint flags a question bead with a sprint:
    10	#   label or under a sprint epic; --type map checks the epic's children.
    11	#
    12	# Every br call goes to a PATH stub that answers from fixture files and logs
    13	# its argv, so no beads database is touched.
    14	# =============================================================================
    15	
    16	setup() {
    17	    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    18	    CREATE_TASK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/create-sprint-task.sh"
    19	    GET_READY="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/get-ready-work.sh"
    20	    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
    21	    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
    22	
    23	    WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
    24	    export BR_FIX="$WORK/fix" BR_LOG="$WORK/br.log"
    25	    mkdir -p "$WORK/bin" "$BR_FIX" "$WORK/cwd"
    26	    : > "$BR_LOG"
    27	    cat > "$WORK/bin/br" <<'STUB'
    28	#!/usr/bin/env bash
    29	# br stub: answers from $BR_FIX, logs argv to $BR_LOG.
    30	printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$BR_LOG"
    31	sub="${1:-}"; shift || true
    32	case "$sub" in
    33	  show)
    34	    f="$BR_FIX/show-$1.json"
    35	    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then cat "$f"; else echo '{"error":"not found"}' >&2; exit 1; fi ;;
    36	  create) echo "CREATE $*" >> "$BR_LOG"; echo '{"id":"bd-new1"}' ;;
    37	  label) [[ "${1:-}" == list ]] && cat "$BR_FIX/labels-${2:-x}.txt" 2>/dev/null; exit 0 ;;
    38	  dep) exit 0 ;;
    39	  ready) cat "$BR_FIX/ready.json" ;;
    40	  list)
    41	    type=all
    42	    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do [[ "$1" == --type ]] && type="$2"; shift; done
    43	    cat "$BR_FIX/list-$type.json" ;;
    44	  *) exit 0 ;;
    45	esac
    46	STUB
    47	    chmod +x "$WORK/bin/br"
    48	    export PATH="$WORK/bin:$PATH"
    49	    cd "$WORK/cwd"
    50	}
    51	
    52	teardown() {
    53	    cd /
    54	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    55	}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tests/unit/charting-lint.bats: decision tickets stay off the build path
     4	# (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-4.7, D-4.8).
     5	#
     6	#   create-sprint-task.sh refuses type question and a map epic before any bead
     7	#   exists; get-ready-work.sh drops question beads whatever their labels and
     8	#   keeps every other type; the implement path selects work through it;
     9	#   validate-artifact.sh --type sprint flags a question bead with a sprint:
    10	#   label or under a sprint epic; --type map checks the epic's children.
    11	#
    12	# Every br call goes to a PATH stub that answers from fixture files and logs
    13	# its argv, so no beads database is touched.
    14	# =============================================================================
    15	
    16	setup() {
    17	    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    18	    CREATE_TASK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/create-sprint-task.sh"

    27	    cat > "$WORK/bin/br" <<'STUB'
    28	#!/usr/bin/env bash
    29	# br stub: answers from $BR_FIX, logs argv to $BR_LOG.
    30	printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$BR_LOG"
    31	sub="${1:-}"; shift || true
    32	case "$sub" in
    33	  show)
    34	    f="$BR_FIX/show-$1.json"
    35	    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then cat "$f"; else echo '{"error":"not found"}' >&2; exit 1; fi ;;

    37	  label) [[ "${1:-}" == list ]] && cat "$BR_FIX/labels-${2:-x}.txt" 2>/dev/null; exit 0 ;;
    38	  dep) exit 0 ;;
    39	  ready) cat "$BR_FIX/ready.json" ;;
    40	  list)
    41	    type=all
    42	    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do [[ "$1" == --type ]] && type="$2"; shift; done
    43	    cat "$BR_FIX/list-$type.json" ;;
    44	  *) exit 0 ;;
    45	esac
    46	STUB
    47	    chmod +x "$WORK/bin/br"
    48	    export PATH="$WORK/bin:$PATH"
    49	    cd "$WORK/cwd"
    50	}

     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tests/unit/spike-validator.bats: the spike discipline (grimoires/loa/sdd.md
     4	# D-5.4, D-5.5, D-5.9).
     5	#
     6	#   validate-artifact.sh --type spike: the template passes; an empty Verdict,
     7	#   a missing section, a Pointer without a branch or path, a Decided by naming
     8	#   neither operator nor agent, a non-spike Branch header and a URL fail.
     9	#   block-destructive-bash.sh: SP-1 cases that need a git checkout (gh pr
    10	#   create with no head on a spike branch), and the spike-delete predicate:
    11	#   force-deleting spike/<slug> passes only with a decided verdict row.
    12	# The command-string shapes of SP-1 live in the fence corpus
    13	# (tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl, rows B50-B59 and D61-D72).
    14	# =============================================================================
    15	
    16	setup() {
    17	    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    18	    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
    19	    TEMPLATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md"
    20	    HOOK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
    21	    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
    22	    WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
    23	    export LOA_REPO_ROOT="$WORK/audit"
    24	    mkdir -p "$LOA_REPO_ROOT"
    25	}
    26	
    27	teardown() {
    28	    cd /
    29	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    30	}
    31	
    32	# A filled-in report.
    33	spike_report() {
    34	    cat <<'EOF'
    35	# Spike: ceiling-ui
    36	
    37	**Bead**: bd-p1
    38	**Branch**: spike/ceiling-ui
    39	**Date**: 2026-10-14
    40	
    41	## Question
    42	Does the ceiling table read better as a chart?
    43	
    44	## What was built
    45	A static page rendering both forms from one fixture.
    46	
    47	## Verdict
    48	The chart, with the table behind a toggle.
    49	
    50	## Pointer
    51	Branch spike/ceiling-ui at commit 1a2b3c4.
    52	
    53	## Decided by
    54	operator, recorded as DEC-0042.
    55	EOF
    56	}
    57	
    58	# Replace the body of section $1 in stdin with $2 (empty: drop the body).
    59	with_section() {
    60	    awk -v want="## $1" -v repl="$2" '
    61	        $0 == want { print; if (repl != "") print repl; skip = 1; next }
    62	        skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
    63	        !skip { print }
    64	    '
    65	}
    66	
    67	hook_in() {
    68	    local dir="$1" cmd="$2"
    69	    (cd "$dir" && jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}' | bash "$HOOK")
    70	}
    71	
    72	# --- validate-artifact.sh --type spike ------------------------------------------
    73	
    74	@test "spike: the shipped template passes" {
    75	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$TEMPLATE"
    76	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    77	}
    78	
    79	@test "spike: a filled-in report passes without warnings" {
    80	    spike_report > "$WORK/r.md"
    81	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
    82	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    83	    [[ "$output" != *"WARN"* ]]
    84	}
    85	
    86	@test "spike: an empty Verdict fails (template and report)" {
    87	    with_section "Verdict" "" < "$TEMPLATE" > "$WORK/t.md"
    88	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/t.md"
    89	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    90	    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
    91	    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" "" > "$WORK/r.md"
    92	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
    93	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    94	    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
    95	}
    96	
    97	@test "spike: each missing section is named" {
    98	    local s
    99	    for s in "Question" "What was built" "Verdict" "Pointer" "Decided by"; do
   100	        spike_report | grep -vxF "## $s" > "$WORK/r.md"
   101	        run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   102	        [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   103	        [[ "$output" == *"missing section '## $s'"* ]]
   104	    done
   105	}
   106	
   107	@test "spike: a Pointer naming neither a spike branch nor a path fails; a path passes" {
   108	    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "the prototype we looked at" > "$WORK/r.md"
   109	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   110	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   111	    [[ "$output" == *"'## Pointer' names neither"* ]]
   112	    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "prototypes/ceiling/index.html" > "$WORK/r.md"
   113	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   114	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   115	}
   116	
   117	@test "spike: Decided by must name operator or agent; a missing DEC id WARNs" {
   118	    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "the team, DEC-0042" > "$WORK/r.md"
   119	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   120	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   121	    [[ "$output" == *"names neither operator nor agent"* ]]
   122	    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "agent" > "$WORK/r.md"
   123	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   124	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   125	    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Decided by' cites no DEC row"* ]]
   126	}
   127	
   128	@test "spike: a Branch header that is not spike/<slug> fails; a multi-line Verdict WARNs" {
   129	    spike_report | sed 's#^\*\*Branch\*\*: spike/ceiling-ui#**Branch**: feature/ceiling-ui#' > "$WORK/r.md"
   130	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   131	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   132	    [[ "$output" == *"is not a spike/<slug> branch"* ]]
   133	    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" $'The chart.\nAlso the table.' > "$WORK/r.md"
   134	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   135	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   136	    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Verdict' has 2 lines"* ]]
   137	}
   138	
   139	@test "spike: a URL fails (plain prose)" {
   140	    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "spike/ceiling-ui, demo at https://example.invalid/demo" > "$WORK/r.md"
   141	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
   142	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   143	    [[ "$output" == *"a URL in the document"* ]]
   144	}
   145	
   146	@test "spike: a report validated on a spike checkout WARNs that it belongs on the working branch" {
   147	    git init -q "$WORK/repo"
   148	    git -C "$WORK/repo" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
   149	    git -C "$WORK/repo" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
   150	    spike_report > "$WORK/repo/r.md"
   151	    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/repo/r.md"
   152	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   153	    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: this checkout is on spike/ceiling-ui"* ]]
   154	}
   155	
   156	# --- SP-1 cases that need a git checkout ------------------------------------------
   157	
   158	spike_repo() {
   159	    REPO="$WORK/repo"
   160	    git init -q "$REPO"
   161	    git -C "$REPO" config user.email t@t
   162	    git -C "$REPO" config user.name t
   163	    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m init
   164	    BASE="$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
   165	    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
   166	    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m "prototype"
   167	    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
   168	}
   169	
   170	@test "SP-1: gh pr create with no head is blocked on a spike branch and allowed on the working branch" {
   171	    spike_repo
   172	    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
   173	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   174	    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q spike/ceiling-ui
   175	    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
   176	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   177	    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
   178	    # an explicit non-spike head is the operator's statement: not judged by branch
   179	    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --head feature/x --title t --body b"
   180	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   181	}
   182	
   183	@test "SP-1: the block message names the allowed forms and the working-branch rule" {
   184	    run hook_in "$WORK" "git merge spike/ceiling-ui"
   185	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   186	    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
   187	    [[ "$output" == *"git push -u origin spike/<slug>"* ]]
   188	    [[ "$output" == *"on the working branch"* ]]
   189	}
   190	
   191	# --- the spike-delete predicate (D-5.9) -------------------------------------------
   192	
   193	skip_without_yq4() {
   194	    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
   195	    yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.' || skip "needs mikefarah yq v4"
   196	}
   197	
   198	# write_ledger <status> <source> <by-of-the-decided-step>
   199	write_ledger() {
   200	    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
   201	    cat > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" <<EOF
   202	schema_version: 1
   203	decisions:
   204	  - id: "DEC-0042"
   205	    status: "$1"
   206	    source: "$2"
   207	    transitions:
   208	      - {at: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z", from: null, to: open, by: "agent:chart"}
   209	      - {at: "2026-10-14T01:00:00Z", from: open, to: proposed, by: "agent:chart"}
   210	      - {at: "2026-10-14T02:00:00Z", from: proposed, to: decided, by: "$3"}
   211	EOF
   212	}
   213	
   214	force_delete() {
   215	    run hook_in "$REPO" "git branch -D $*"
   216	}
   217	
   218	@test "D-5.9: force-deleting an unmerged spike branch is blocked without a ledger row" {
   219	    spike_repo
   220	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   221	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   222	    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [FR-1.1]"* ]]
   223	    [[ "$output" == *"whose verdict row"* ]]
   224	}
   225	
   226	@test "D-5.9: a decided verdict row (operator step) for the spike's report allows the delete" {
   227	    skip_without_yq4
   228	    spike_repo
   229	    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
   230	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   231	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   232	    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md#verdict" "operator:decisions-command"
   233	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   234	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   235	}
   236	
   237	@test "D-5.9: a proposed row, an agent decided step, or another spike's row keeps the block" {
   238	    skip_without_yq4
   239	    spike_repo
   240	    write_ledger proposed "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
   241	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   242	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   243	    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "agent:chart"
   244	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   245	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   246	    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/other.md" "operator:decisions-command"
   247	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   248	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   249	}
   250	
   251	@test "D-5.9: every name must qualify; an unmerged non-spike branch beside a decided spike keeps the block" {
   252	    skip_without_yq4
   253	    spike_repo
   254	    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b feature/wip
   255	    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m wip
   256	    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
   257	    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
   258	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui feature/wip
   259	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   260	}
   261	
   262	@test "D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block" {
   263	    skip_without_yq4
   264	    spike_repo
   265	    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
   266	    printf 'decisions: [unclosed\n' > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
   267	    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
   268	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   269	}

--- a/tests/unit/run-mode-ice.bats
+++ b/tests/unit/run-mode-ice.bats
@@ -319,3 +319,139 @@ skip_if_script_missing() {
   [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   [[ "$output" == *"Usage"* ]]
 }
+
+# ============================================================================
+# Spike branches (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-5.3): push allowed, never merged into
+# another branch, never a PR; the default branch may be merged into a spike.

+
+# The repo's default branch name (git init picks main or master).

+

+ice_gh_stub() {
+  mkdir -p "$TEST_TMPDIR/bin"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+echo "gh $*" >> "$GH_LOG"
+echo "https://example.invalid/pr/1"
+STUB
+  chmod +x "$TEST_TMPDIR/bin/gh"
+  export GH_LOG="$TEST_TMPDIR/gh.log"
+  : > "$GH_LOG"
+  export PATH="$TEST_TMPDIR/bin:$PATH"
+}

+@test "is_spike_branch: spike/x and remote or full spike refs are spike branches" {
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" is-spike spike/x

+  [[ "$output" == "true" ]]
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" is-spike origin/spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" is-spike refs/heads/spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "is_spike_branch: feature branches and lookalikes are not spike branches" {
+  local b
+  for b in feature/test main spike spikes/x myspike/x spike-x; do
+    run "$ICE_SCRIPT" is-spike "$b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == "false" ]]
+  done
+}
+
+@test "cli: is-spike requires branch arg" {
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" is-spike
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Usage"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a spike branch is not protected, and safe_push pushes it" {
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" is-protected spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  git init --bare --quiet "$TEST_TMPDIR/remote.git"
+  git remote add origin "$TEST_TMPDIR/remote.git"
+  git checkout -b spike/x --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" push origin spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  git --git-dir="$TEST_TMPDIR/remote.git" rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/spike/x
+}
+
+@test "safe_merge: the old call shape (no source) stays ALWAYS blocked, also on a spike branch" {
+  git checkout -b spike/x --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED"* ]]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Human intervention"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "safe_merge: merging the default branch into a spike branch is allowed and merges" {
+  local base; base="$(ice_default_branch)"
+  [ -n "$base" ]
+  git checkout -b spike/x --quiet
+  git checkout "$base" --quiet
+  echo "more" > MORE.md && git add MORE.md && git commit -m "base moves on" --quiet
+  git checkout spike/x --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge "$base"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ -f MORE.md ]
+}
+
+@test "safe_merge: a spike source is refused with the spike message, whatever the current branch" {
+  git branch spike/x
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"ICE: spike branches are never merged into another branch"* ]]
+  git checkout -b spike/y --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge origin/spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"never merged into another branch"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "safe_merge: the default branch into a feature branch stays blocked" {
+  local base; base="$(ice_default_branch)"
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge "$base"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "safe_merge: on a spike branch, a source other than the default branch stays blocked" {
+  git checkout -b spike/x --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge feature/test
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED"* ]]
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" merge --abort
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "safe_pr_create: a spike head is refused and gh never runs" {
+  ice_gh_stub
+  git checkout -b spike/x --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" pr-create "Title" "Body"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"ICE: spike branches never get a PR"* ]]
+  [[ "$output" == *"ICE BLOCK"* ]]
+  [ ! -s "$GH_LOG" ]
+  git checkout feature/test --quiet
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" pr-create "Title" "Body" main spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  [ ! -s "$GH_LOG" ]
+}
+
+@test "safe_pr_create: a feature head still creates a draft PR (control)" {
+  ice_gh_stub
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" pr-create "Title" "Body"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q -- '--draft' "$GH_LOG"
+  grep -q -- '--head feature/test' "$GH_LOG"
+}
+
+@test "spike: ICE has no cherry-pick operation (a Miss of the ICE seam; the fence rule SP-1 blocks it)" {
+  run "$ICE_SCRIPT" cherry-pick spike/x
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Unknown command"* ]]
+  grep -q 'cherry-pick spike/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl"
+}

     [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -c 'which the PRD marks \*\*Deferred:\*\*')" -eq 1 ]
     [[ "$output" == *"sprint.md:10: this task cites FR-5"* ]]
 }
+
+# =============================================================================
+# map (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-4.8, §4.2)
+# =============================================================================
+
+# A map doc in the §4.2 shape; outside the project, so the beads check is a WARN.
+map_fixture() {
+    cat <<'MAP'
+# Map: Ceiling arc
+
+**Slug**: ceiling-arc
+**Status**: charting
+**Epic**: bd-map1
+**Created**: 2026-10-14
+
+## Destination
+The Opus ceiling is measured on every transport.
+
+## Decisions so far
+- Transport (DEC-0001, bd-c1): headless first
+
+## Not yet specified
+- retry budget
+
+## Out of scope
+- pricing: another cycle
+MAP
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: a valid map doc passes (beads check skipped with one WARN outside the project)" {
+    map_fixture > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: beads cross-check skipped"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: a final ## Closed section passes; any section after it fails" {
+    { map_fixture; printf '\n## Closed\n2026-10-20, consumed by cycle-129\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    printf '\n## Out of scope\n- again\n' >> "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"after '## Closed'"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: an extra H2 fails (no execution override)" {
+    { map_fixture; printf '\n## Execution override\nImplement it now under src/.\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Execution override' is not a map section"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"carries no execution instructions"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: an H2 inside a fenced code block is not a section" {
+    { map_fixture; printf '\n```\n## Not a heading\n```\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: a Decisions so far bullet without a DEC id fails" {
+    map_fixture | sed 's/(DEC-0001, bd-c1)/(bd-c1)/' > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"bullet cites no DEC row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: sections out of order, a missing section and a second H1 each fail" {
+    map_fixture | awk '/^## Not yet specified/{skip=1} /^## Out of scope/{skip=0} !skip' > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"missing section '## Not yet specified'"* ]]
+    { map_fixture | sed 's/^## Destination$/## Decisions so far/; 0,/^## Decisions so far$/!{s/^## Decisions so far$/## Destination/}'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"out of order or repeated"* ]]
+    { map_fixture; printf '\n# Plan\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"exactly one H1"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: a bad Status, a missing Slug or Epic, and an empty Destination fail" {
+    map_fixture | sed 's/^\*\*Status\*\*: charting/**Status**: building/' > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"**Status** 'building' is not one of"* ]]
+    map_fixture | grep -vE '^\*\*(Slug|Epic)\*\*:' > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"no '**Slug**:' header"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"no '**Epic**:' header"* ]]
+    map_fixture | grep -v '^The Opus ceiling' > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Destination' is empty"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: every documented Status value passes" {
+    local st
+    for st in charting handed-off closed abandoned; do
+        map_fixture | sed "s/^\*\*Status\*\*: charting/**Status**: $st/" > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+        run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+        [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "validate-artifact map: a URL and a three-line blockquote fail (plain prose)" {
+    { map_fixture; printf -- '- see https://example.invalid/x\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"a URL in the document"* ]]
+    { map_fixture; printf '\n> one\n> two\n> three\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"

+    [[ "$output" == *"a blockquote of 3 lines"* ]]
+    { map_fixture; printf '\n> one\n> two\n'; } > "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type map --file "${TEST_TMPDIR}/map.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}

EPIC_ID="${POSITIONAL[0]:-}"
TITLE="${POSITIONAL[1]:-}"
PRIORITY="${POSITIONAL[2]:-2}"
TYPE="${POSITIONAL[3]:-task}"

# A --deps value that is empty (or trims to empty) is neither edges nor an
# assertion — it would slip through the edge-or-none rule unnoticed. Refuse
# it. Trimming here also makes '--deps " none "' a valid assertion. A value

done
EOF

content.text:
The review is written to `review.md` with the verdict `CHANGES_REQUIRED`.

**What I found**

- **Blocking, verified by reproduction.** The new spike-delete exception in the destructive-bash hook fails open. When the decision ledger cannot be parsed, yq produces no output, and on jq 1.6 `jq -e` on empty input exits 0, so `git branch -D spike/<slug>` is allowed. The hook intentionally runs without pipefail, so nothing catches the yq failure. The PR's own test for this case fails on this system.
- **Design contradiction.** The map validator requires `DEC-NNNN` ids in both the doc bullets and bead external refs, but chart-ticket.sh and the reference doc explicitly produce `PEND-` ids when charting in a linked worktree. Any map charted there fails the validation step the skill mandates.
- **Prefix ambiguity.** Research markers and reports are named `chart-<slug>-<ticket>`, and both parts may contain hyphens. Map `eval` counts and inlines artifacts belonging to map `eval-workers`, which corrupts the five-dispatch cap and the hand-off snapshot.
- **Smaller defects.** The skill instructs a `source` command its own allow-list forbids. The plan-and-analyze generic context glob still ingests the snapshots the multi-map rule rejected. The build-path filter and the frontier disagree on the JSON field for issue type. The br stub accepts any unknown flag, so the suites cannot catch a wrong flag name against real beads_rust. Plus a few cosmetic items (help text ranges, a stale header comment, a missing newline in a failure listing).

**What I verified by running**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| chart-frontier.bats | 12 of 12 pass |
| run-mode-ice.bats | 50 of 50 pass |
| charting-lint.bats (scripts without untouched libs) | 13 of 13 pass |
| spike-validator hook tests | 6 of 7 pass, unparsable-ledger case fails |
| fence corpus rows B50-B59, D61-D72 | 22 of 22 match expectations |
| unattended-prototype.bats | 6 of 6 pass |

Suites that need untouched files (validate-artifact, golden-path, chart-ticket end to end) could not run from the frozen copy.

**Next step for the author.** Fix the hook so a failed ledger lookup keeps the block, then settle the PEND versus DEC question in the validator or in chart-ticket, and switch the research artifact naming to a delimiter that cannot appear in a slug.
